title: Optimizing the Upper-Bound Constant for the Crossing Number of Polynomial Curve Systems
summary: Baader, Jörg, and Parlier recently established an upper bound for the crossing number of curve systems of size $m\asymp g^{1+α}$ on a genus $g$ surface, obtaining a leading coefficient of $9/4=2.25$. Their construction relies on fibre surfaces associated with complete bipartite graphs and uses a symmetric parameter choice corresponding to the central binomial coefficient. In this note, we optimize their construction by relaxing the parameter symmetry and solving the resulting entropy balance problem.
